sources.title: Overview - nunchaku_lite
sources.snippet: nunchaku_lite loads Nunchaku-quantized image generation components into standard Diffusers pipelines. It keeps the integration surface small: construct the target Diffusers pipeline, replace only the quantized transformer or UNet, and keep scheduling, prompting, LoRA loading, and image generation in regular Diffusers code.
